consequence.statement: The tracing.datadog.globaltag configuration option is ignored and has no effect.

original.statement: The tracing.datadog.globaltag configuration option has been removed and is no longer honored in Traefik 3.0.0.

consequence.statement: The `tracing.datadog.globaltag` option has been removed, so a configured value for it is no longer honoured in Traefik v3. The upstream text does not say whether the leftover key is silently ignored or rejected.
consequence.remediation: Remove `tracing.datadog.globaltag` from the tracing configuration before upgrading to v3.

corrected.statement: In Traefik 3.0.0 the `tracing.datadog.globaltag` option has been removed. If it is still configured, its value is no longer honoured.

decision.reason: [ev-4a489b1e9ff3] says the `tracing.datadog.globaltag` option has been removed in v3, which falls under the "Deprecated Options Removal" section. A value set for a removed key is no longer honoured, so setting-ignored (action) at medium severity is supported. The proposed statement goes too far: it says the option is silently "ignored and has no effect", but the evidence never says whether Traefik silently ignores the key or rejects it. The corrected statement keeps the kind and severity and only says what the evidence supports.
